smoothShot.title: Mouse Wrist Support for Gaming & Work | Ergonomic Wrist Rest for Long Computer Sessions | Desk Setup Accessory
smoothShot.description:
Comfort for work. Control for play.

A wearable wrist glide support designed for smoother mouse movement, better control, and all-day comfort.

Benefits
✔ Reduces wrist drag on mouse pads
✔ Supports smoother mouse movement
✔ Improves comfort during long sessions
✔ Helps reduce fatigue during work or play

How It Works
1. Strap Smooth Shot to your wrist
2. Rest the glide surface on your mouse pad
3. Move naturally with reduced friction

Perfect For
• Gamers
• Work-from-home setups
• Creatives and designers
• Anyone spending long hours on a computer

Perfect for both productivity and play.

📦 What You Get
1x Smooth Shot Wrist Support

Materials:
• 3D-printed body (PLA)
• Glass glide surface
• Adjustable nylon strap
